about: PDUFA goal-date extensions for pdufa.bio's /pdufa-date-changes page (build_date_changes.py). 'rows' holds extensions found after the 2024-2025 decision-timing census (decision_timing_2024_2025.json), in the census's field names: goal_date_original / goal_original_url / goal_original_quote, goal_date_extended / goal_extended_url / goal_extended_quote, extension_reason, action_date / action_url / outcome, and for a pending row whose extended date has passed, after_note / after_url (a public sentence on what the sponsor said later, with its source). 'reasons' is the public sentence shown for each extension's stated reason, keyed by census cid or 'TICKER|extended-date', written from the quoted documents; an extension with no entry here shows 'No reason stated in the documents read'.

reasons.C331: Sanofi said the FDA determined that additional analyses submitted during the review were a major amendment, extending the target date by three months.
reasons.C330: Omeros said the date was extended after its comprehensive response to an FDA information request; its release does not use the term major amendment.
reasons.C325: Cytokinetics said the FDA requested a REMS during the review, which was a major amendment, and that no additional clinical data were requested.
reasons.C317: BioCryst said its submission of additional final reports and formulation data was a major amendment.
reasons.C329: Agios said the FDA requested a REMS for potential hepatocellular injury, that its REMS submission was a major amendment, and that the extension was not due to new efficacy or safety data.
reasons.C313: Axogen said its response to an information request included substantial new manufacturing and facility data, which made it a major amendment.
reasons.L104: The FDA's Complete Response Letter states that a major amendment extended the goal date by three months.
reasons.L102: The FDA's Complete Response Letter states that a major amendment extended the goal date by three months.
reasons.C226: Eton said the FDA applied a standard three-month extension to conduct a full review of supplemental information.
reasons.L087: Stealth BioTherapeutics said the FDA advised that supplemental submissions made after the advisory committee meeting were major amendments.
reasons.C183: The FDA's review states that a major amendment received on November 12, 2024 extended the review by three months.
reasons.C151: Organon said the FDA requested final datasets and the clinical study report from the long-term extension study and deemed them a major amendment.
reasons.C165: Amgen said the extension allows time to review recently submitted supplemental data.
reasons.C144: Syndax said its submission was deemed a major amendment and the extension gives the FDA time for a full review of the supplemental information.
reasons.C098: Ascendis said the FDA deemed information submitted during the review a major amendment.
reasons.C081: Rocket said the FDA extended the review to assess clarifying manufacturing (CMC) information it submitted in response to FDA information requests.
reasons.C082: The FDA's review records a major amendment.
reasons.C011: Iovance said the FDA extended the date because of resource constraints, not a major amendment.
reasons.C006: Heron said the FDA extended the date by three months to provide for a full review of the submission.
reasons.CAPR|2026-11-22: The FDA classified a submission during review as a major amendment, which extends the review by three months.
reasons.PRAX|2026-12-27: The FDA deemed the sponsor's submission of additional sensitivity analyses of existing clinical data a major amendment.
reasons.BLTE|2027-05-12: The sponsor said the extension gives the FDA additional time to review information provided in support of the application.
reasons.LNTH|2026-06-29: The sponsor said the extension gives the FDA additional time to review further manufacturing information it submitted, and that it was not related to the efficacy or safety data.
reasons.VRTX|2027-02-28: The sponsor said the FDA classified its response to an information request near the end of the review cycle as a major amendment.
reasons.SVRA|2026-11-22: Savara said the FDA determined that its responses to recent information requests were a major amendment, and that the FDA raised no safety, efficacy or manufacturing concerns.
